Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially misidentified Zaheer as fitting the “introduced one season, main antagonist the next” pattern and incorrectly asserted he was introduced in Season 2. This factual error set the investigation on a faulty premise, causing repeated, redundant searches to validate a non-fact instead of focusing on Kuvira, who was correctly introduced in Season 3 and became the main antagonist in Season 4 (yielding the season “third”).
